limitations: Proved for (a) in general and for (b)/(c) whenever the base rule 0 1^q -> 1^r 0^(s/p) has a known loop (all q <= 6, s/p <= 6); termination proved only for s <= p or r <= q. The 24 open rules with parameters <= 5 (all predicted terminating) include Zantema's problem.
novelty_basis: Termination of this family is completely characterised by Zantema and Geser (RTA 1995, LNCS 914; AAECC 11(1):1-25, 2000). We could not retrieve the statement of their theorem, so whether H-C03-4 coincides with it is unverified; if it differs, theirs takes precedence.
statement:
0^p 1^q -> 1^r 0^s (p, q, r, s >= 1) is non-terminating iff (a) r >= 2q and s >= 2p, or (b) s >= 2p,
q < r < 2q and p divides s, or (c) r >= 2q, p < s < 2p and q divides r. Otherwise it terminates.
title: Divisibility characterization of termination for 0^p 1^q -> 1^r 0^s (H-C03-4)
